summary: Concorde International Group Ltd (Nasdaq: CIGL), a British Virgin Islands company, filed a Form 6-K notifying Nasdaq of its election to follow certain BVI corporate governance practices instead of specific Nasdaq listing rules. The company will rely on BVI law and its governing documents to avoid holding an annual shareholder meeting within one year of fiscal year-end (Rule 5620(a)) and to bypass shareholder approval for certain equity compensation plans (Rule 5635(c)). This is a routine foreign private issuer governance notification, not a special transaction, but it is an unusual corporate governance event. What to watch: any Nasdaq response or potential delisting risk if the election is challenged.
